content.text: I need the current weather in Tokyo and in Paris. Use the get_weather tool once per city, then compare the two cities in one short paragraph that mentions both city names.

body.instructions: You are a weather assistant. You have access to a get_weather tool. You must call the get_weather tool for any weather question and never guess weather data. After receiving the tool result, provide a concise summary of the weather.

tools.description: Get the current weather for a city. Must be called for weather questions.
tools.name: get_weather

city.description: City name to get weather for
